1446. Minimum Swaps to Sort Array-2

Problem Statement:
You are given an array of distinct integers. Your task is to find the minimum number of swaps required to sort the array.
input_spec: First line contains an integer, n, the number of elements in the array. Second line contains n space-separated integers, the elements of the array.
output_spec: Output a single integer, the minimum number of swaps required to sort the array.
